messages:
nina: Quick thread to lock down GA-entry gating owners. We need explicit acceptance checks for SLA wording, public docs, oncall staffing, monitoring alerts, and pricing/billing readiness. Can each lead confirm ownership & a single green criterion?

omar: I'll take runtime SLOs and rollout controls. Green: p95 <= 120ms for dedicated customers, p99 <= 500ms for hosted. Also require canary at 3% for 24h with no severity >=P2.

tara: Support lead: I'll own triage playbook + Ops runbook. Green: PagerDuty schedule created + a 24/7 two-week rotation for post-GA ramp. Need a dedicated channel `#ga-support` and runbook link.

ezra: Monitoring/alerts: I'll own alerts + dashboards. Proposed critical alerts: sustained errors > 1% for 10m, p99 latency increase > 2x baseline over 10m, KV cache miss spike. Example PromQL: 
```
# errors > 1% of requests
sum(rate(redwood_errors_total[10m])) / sum(rate(redwood_requests_total[10m])) > 0.01
# p99 jump
histogram_quantile(0.99, sum(rate(redwood_latency_bucket[5m])) by (le)) > 2 * baseline_p99
```
Will wire those to Severity P1/P2 and link runbooks.

felix: Legal/compliance check: I'll review contracts and data handling notes. Green: data retention table + KMS usage documented and privacy review signed. Need sample logs and opt-out wording for telemetry.

ryan: Finance: I'll own pricing readiness and invoice previews. Green: billing events emitted for every route with pilot flag, invoice-preview UI shows sample month, and SKU mapping completed. Provide CSV schema for export.

nina: Docs: who owns customer-facing SLA page + developer quickstart? We need both public and internal runbooks.

omar: Engineering will provide API spec + error codes by Tue. We'll add explicit retry semantics and idempotency notes.

tara: I'll draft the customer "what to expect" short doc and escalation matrix. ETA Wed noon. Will include links to support SLAs and expected MTTR windows.

ezra: Also proposing a 72-hour freeze on infra changes during GA cut, and a rollback play: traffic back to previous model binary + revert routing flags. Put these in runbook.

nina: OK action list: owners to add a single-line green gating criterion to the launch board, attach artifacts (docs, runbooks, dash links), and mark dependencies. I'll do a final gating review Thu 16:00 PT.

omar: One ask: define acceptable error types vs degradation. I'll post a short taxonomy (client errors vs server vs model-failure) and map to fallback policies.

felix: I'll need the telemetry retention table and sample PII scrubbers by EOD Tue to sign off.

ryan: Billing event example: `{"route":"text.generate","pilot_flag":true,"tokens":1234,"customer_id":"acct_ABC"}`. Will validate with analytics team.

tara: Creating `#ga-support` and PagerDuty schedule now. Will ping owners when both are live.

nina: Perfect. If anyone needs to swap ownership, call it out here. Otherwise please post your green tick on the board and upload artifacts. Final gating review Thu 16:00 PT. :rocket:
